what_differs: WAGR-225 (Jumpr Review) builds Deal_Name__c / Deal__c labels as Operator - Market - Vertical with no partner. The 2026-08-11 client sync decided the global deal name includes the partner code (state/country, operator, partner code, vertical), and 2026-08-25 added the source suffix. The Name flow (WAGR-147) follows the decision; the WAGR-225 formula fields do not.
suggested_action: Do not pass WAGR-225 review as written. Either retire the Deal_Name__c / Deal__c formula fields (Name is now flow-generated) or update them to the agreed format with partner code and source.
